versions.changelog: Improve Codeflow enforcer reliability and control routing: add deterministic control flow, better plugin state detection across runtime/npx/nvm environments, gateway-edited install/status replies, and automatic allowlisting before install.

Add deterministic /codeflow control routing, improve enforcer install and OpenClaw detection across native/npx/nvm setups, support gateway-edited control replies/buttons, and tighten plugin allowlisting/docs.
Bundle the codeflow-enforcer plugin with soft /codeflow fallback, add guard current status, precheck review/parallel before side effects, and harden Discord relay/thread handling.
Enforce stdin prompts for Codex/Claude; add CODEFLOW_PROMPT_MODE; update docs + review/parallel.
